summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term, ultra-LEAPS bullish bets on the SPX, evidenced by massive accumulations of 7000C strikes expiring in 2026 and 2027 totaling billions in premium. While NVDA and MU show heavy put buying, the persistent multi-day accumulation of SPX 7000C (over $1.6B across multiple dates) and SPX 8000P indicates a massive, structured hedging or "tail-risk" strategy targeting extreme volatility. Traders should watch for continued strength in AMD (P/C 0.59) and SPY (P/C 0.72) to confirm short-term bullish momentum, while monitoring if the heavy put buying in INTC and GLD triggers a breakdown in those specific sectors.
